item.title: ABC News: Bug warfare at century-old Sydney rose garden to help deter pests
item.description: A collective of ladybirds and "gruesome" parasitic wasps have been tasked with managing an aphid infestation in a historic garden.

item.title: ABC News: Row erupts at exclusive club over membership for Russian diplomat's wife
item.description: Canberra diplomats are embroiled in a diplomatic row after a historic social club admitted the Russian ambassador's wife, prompting a member walkout led by his Ukrainian counterpart's wife.

item.title: ABC News: New field test picks up deadly tumour disease in Tassie devils
item.description: A newly developed field test that can immediately detect the deadly facial tumour disease in Tasmanian devils could one day help combat declining population numbers around the state.

item.title: ABC News: HungryPanda delivery rider's fatal stabbing impacts election
item.description: Some in the Chinese community say the fatal stabbing of a delivery driver is evidence that crime is at "an appalling level".

item.title: ABC News: Rising costs hurt South Australia's regional high streets
item.description: Several shops in Mount Gambier's economic heart stand empty as rising costs and changing shopping habits take a toll.

item.title: ABC News: You Can See Everything is a surreal, brain-melting documentary
item.description: Just over a month before starting an 11-year prison sentence, Theranos fraudster Elizabeth Holmes let comedian Nathen Fielder into her home. The results are nothing less than sublime.

item.title: ABC News: Swimming embraces short and sharp with new Swim GP competition
item.description: Traditional swimming competitions are no longer enough, as Swimming Australia continues to explore alternative formats with the Swim GP in Melbourne, and the return of the International Swimming League in London this December.

item.title: ABC News: These women experienced alleged bullying so severe, they're no longer Catholic
item.description: A Catholic order is engaged in an extraordinary legal stoush with people it employed to investigate child abuse, who claim they were subjected to bullying and intimidation so severe it has robbed them of their faith.

item.title: ABC News: Gardening program helping friendships bloom between generations
item.description: In Hobart, a gardening program that matches older people with volunteers to help with garden maintenance and provide social support often leads to social connection and friendship.

item.title: ABC News: It's Booker season. Test your knowledge of the world's top literary prize
item.description: Who won the Booker Prize in 2026? And what is the "Booker bounce"? Do our quiz to find out.

item.title: ABC News: Is Robyn pop music’s most influential heartbreaker?
item.description: She redefined pop music and wrote the heartbreak anthem of our time. Here’s what you need to know about Robyn before her long-awaited Australian return.

item.title: ABC News: Plug-in solar and batteries may cause house fires, electricians warn
item.description: Plug-in solar and batteries promise savings for households, but electrical industry groups say the safety measures being proposed are insufficient and the devices could cause house fires.
